name: atlas-compact-ask
goal: Two pure modules for the crew harness itself, from the ATLAS strengthening study (Kris, 2026-10-26): compact.py keeps a long job's findings and warns before the token budget runs out (33 runs ended on it), ask.py lets a stuck member ask one question instead of looping (66 runs ended stuck). The PA wires both into crew/agent.py and crew/core.py.

tasks.instructions: Walk every worked-example row. Copy every message string character for character from the contract - the hidden tests compare whole strings. budget_line's rules apply in order, and the requests rule comes first. render_notes keeps a run of the NEWEST lines, never a best fit.
tasks.test_instructions: Cover every table row, the newest-run rule of render_notes (a short old note is dropped when a newer long one does not fit), the floor in the budget percentage, max_tokens of 0, the requests rule winning over the tokens rule, and stub leaving content of exactly keep_chars unchanged.

tasks.instructions: Walk every worked-example row. parse_question's rules apply in order and the first failure decides the message; lengths are judged AFTER cleaning. Copy USAGE and HINT character for character. Do not change the args dict you are given.
tasks.test_instructions: Cover every table row, the inclusive limits (400 and 80 characters, 4 options), the rule order (an empty question is reported before bad options), numbered answers out of range, and that parse_question leaves its input unchanged.
